title: Run Summary (--json form)
description: The machine-readable form of the structured run summary (NFR-5). The DEFAULT output is human-readable prose; this JSON form is the opt-in --json output. Both ports MUST emit byte-identical JSON for identical inputs (Constitution VI, canonical serialisation per research §11).

dry_run.description: True when produced by a --dry-run twin; the action set MUST equal the real run's (FR-033).

actions.description: The ordered write-action set of a reconcile run; the --dry-run report equals the real run's set exactly (FR-033). URLs are host-relative — the site host is a coordinate that never appears in output (Constitution IV).

warnings.description: Human-readable lifecycle-safety warnings (withheld transitions, drift); present only when lifecycle facts were supplied.

notes.description: Non-gating informational notes (e.g. open blocking links named per FR-037); present only when lifecycle facts were supplied.

effects.description: The effects of a /speckit.jira.config run, reported SEPARATELY (FR-054).

drift.description: Named drift warnings per ticket + divergent field (FR-031).

flags.description: Tickets carrying Jira's Flagged marker; transitions withheld by default (FR-036).

blockers.description: Open blocking links named as info, non-gating (FR-037).

hook_health.description: Hook health checked and reported on every run (FR-047). A pure READ of the consuming repository's hook registry: computing it writes nothing, and the registry itself is never written by this extension in any state (003 FR-022).

held_disabled.description: Events the operator disabled, recorded in the gitignored local binding and honoured at dispatch whatever the registry currently says (003 FR-007, FR-029). A cross-cutting annotation, not a further partition: an event here may also be `present` when the last install re-enabled it.

duplicated.description: Events carrying a leftover pre-manifest entry of this extension — our command with no owning `extension` field. The official install cannot purge it (its predicate matches on that field), so it is duplicated rather than replaced and the operator must remove it by hand (003 FR-028).

unreadable.description: The registry could not be read at all. When true the three partition lists are EMPTY: the extension has no evidence either way and MUST NOT report the events as missing (003 FR-024).

repair_hint.description: The remedy for whatever is not `present`, named literally: the official install command for `missing`, the release flag for `held_disabled`, the manual edit for `duplicated`. Present only when something is not `present` (FR-047, 003 FR-021).

exit_code.description: The documented, monotonically escalating exit code (see cli-contract.md).

status.description: The first six are WRITE outcomes, for effects that write a file this extension owns. The last five are the READ-ONLY verification vocabulary of the hooks effect (003 contracts/hook-registry-entry.md): that effect classifies and reports the consuming repository's hook registry and never writes it, so no write outcome could honestly describe it.

projects.description: The per-project style audit of the discovery effect (002 FR-003): style plus its provenance, per bound project key.
